_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. descript.com is a single-theme Next.js + Tailwind marketing site: a #fff7fa blush field, maroon CTAs and a deep-maroon hero band. Its stylesheet declares the Red/Maroon/Lilac/Neutral/Green/Gray palette scales plus Core canvas constants and Tools-Glow pastels (exported under core.color.*); the measured roles under light.* alias to the declared values where they match.

sans.value: booton, "booton Fallback", system-ui, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
sans.source: computed fontFamily of nav-link, signup-cta, flow-tab, pr-toggle (raw/components-computed.json); pr-card, pr-cta, site-footer and st-prose compute the same stack with Tailwind's fallback list repeated after it
sans.description: Booton — UI, body copy, nav, buttons and every form control on descript.com.

auth.source: computed fontFamily of au-email, au-email-btn, au-google, au-password, au-sso (raw/components-computed.json)
auth.description: Booton VF — the auth card on web.descript.com names the variable face instead of booton.

label.value: brett, "brett Fallback", system-ui, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
label.source: computed fontFamily of hero-eyebrow, pr-eyebrow, m-eyebrow (raw/components-computed.json)
label.description: Brett — the small uppercase eyebrow labels.

display.source: computed fontFamily of hero-display, section-h2, pr-display, vid-h1, tpl-h1 (raw/components-computed.json)
display.description: Gamuth Display — every display heading, hero 88px to section 56px.

medium.description: 500 — the auth card's Booton VF buttons.

semibold.description: 600 — nav items, CTAs, plan names, section h2s.

hero.description: The 88px Gamuth home display (clamped by viewport).

page.source: computed backgroundColor of mkt-header default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.neutral.0
page.description: The #fff7fa blush field (Neutral-0) the nav, cards and page paint.

footer.source: computed backgroundColor of site-footer default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.neutral.950

toggle-track.source: computed backgroundColor of pr-toggle default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.neutral.50
toggle-track.description: The #f1eaed warm-grey track behind the Monthly/Annual options — the same wash nav links take on hover.

ink.source: computed color of nav-link default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.neutral.900
ink.description: The #26171d marketing ink (Neutral-900) — nav text, story prose, headings.

body.source: computed color of pr-card default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.gray.900
body.description: The #1a1a1a Gray-900 body text on pricing, templates and the auth card.

accent.source: computed color of hero-eyebrow default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.red.450
accent.description: The #f73b3b Red-450 — the uppercase eyebrow labels and red CTAs.

on-dark.source: computed color of hero-display default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.red.0
on-dark.description: The #fff8f4 near-white (Red-0) display text over the dark hero band.

muted-on-dark.description: The #c4b5bb muted mauve — unselected workflow-tab text over the dark band.

focus.description: The #101010 1px auto focus outline on light controls.

tab-selected.source: painted background of the selected workflow tab inside flow-tabs default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.maroon.800
tab-selected.description: The #5b142e Maroon-800 fill the selected workflow tab paints.

primary.source: computed backgroundColor of signup-cta default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.maroon.700
primary.description: The #772a4d Maroon-700 — the Sign up button and primary CTA fill.

primary-hover.source: computed backgroundColor of signup-cta hover (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.maroon.800
primary-hover.description: The #5b142e Maroon-800 the maroon buttons deepen to on hover/pressed.

deep.source: computed backgroundColor of pr-cta default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.maroon.900
deep.description: The #390a1a Maroon-900 — the pricing plan CTAs.

red.source: computed backgroundColor of vid-cta default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.red.450
red.description: The #f73b3b Red-450 — the red hero CTAs.

red-hover.source: computed backgroundColor of vid-cta hover (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.red.600
red-hover.description: The #b81b1e the red CTAs deepen to on hover.

red-pressed.source: computed backgroundColor of vid-cta pressed (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.red.700
red-pressed.description: The #8f0c10 Red-700 the red CTAs deepen to when pressed.

auth-primary.source: computed backgroundColor of au-email-btn default (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.neutral.800
auth-primary.description: The #3f2a32 maroon-grey — the auth card's primary button.

auth-outline.description: The #fdfcfc field/outline fill on the auth card's secondary buttons and input.

hover-wash.source: computed backgroundColor of nav-link hover (raw/components-computed.json); matches declared color.neutral.50
hover-wash.description: The #f1eaed warm-grey wash nav links take on hover — the same as the billing-toggle track.

auth-control.description: The 40px auth-card buttons and field (308px wide).

signup-track.source: computed styles of signup-cta across states (raw/components-computed.json)
signup-track.description: Sign up button: #772a4d Maroon-700 fill/white text at rest; hover+pressed deepen to #5b142e Maroon-800; focus shows the 1px auto outline.

red-cta-track.source: computed styles of vid-cta across states (raw/components-computed.json)
red-cta-track.description: Red CTA: #f73b3b Red-450 at rest; #b81b1e on hover; #8f0c10 Red-700 pressed; focus shows the 1px auto outline.

nav-link-track.source: computed styles of nav-link across states (raw/components-computed.json)
nav-link-track.description: Nav item: transparent/#26171d at rest; the #f1eaed warm-grey wash on hover/pressed; focus shows the 1px auto outline.

flow-tab-track.source: computed styles of flow-tab across states (raw/components-computed.json)
flow-tab-track.description: Workflow tab: muted #c4b5bb text on the dark band at rest; #26171d ink wash on hover; opened selects the #5b142e Maroon-800 fill with #fff7fd text.

toggle-track.source: computed styles of pr-toggle-annual across states (raw/components-computed.json)
toggle-track.description: Billing-toggle option: transparent/#1a1a1a at rest on the #f1eaed track; opened is the Annual-selected state; focus shows the 1px auto outline.

auth-primary-track.source: computed styles of au-email-btn across states (raw/components-computed.json)
auth-primary-track.description: Auth primary: #3f2a32 at rest; a 90%-alpha oklab shade on hover/pressed.

template-card-track.source: computed styles of tpl-link across states (raw/components-computed.json)
template-card-track.description: Template card overlay: no paint change across hover/pressed; focus-visible paints a 2px inset ring.

focus-ring.source: computed outline of signup-cta/nav controls focus-visible (raw/components-computed.json)
focus-ring.description: The browser's 1px auto outline in #101010 — no custom focus ring is painted on buttons; template cards paint a 2px inset ring.
